snippet.title: U TSU TSU TSU // Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4423590/U_TSU_TSU_TSU/

Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone’s expectations.

Developed by
YONAMI Games
